limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Classical complemented-subspace and unconditional-basis results for ℓ_p⊕ℓ_q are close qualitative antecedents, and the 1973, 1976, and 1978 Studia Mathematica papers were not all inspected in full. The novelty claim is restricted to the block-independent quantitative threshold formula and its sharp power-weight projection-constant consequences.
provenance: A sign-averaging reduction makes every projection onto a diagonal graph block-diagonal without increasing its norm. The resulting coefficient identities combine with the exact ℓ_q-to-ℓ_p block-multiplier norm to give a reciprocal-tail lower bound, while an explicit threshold projection gives the matching upper bound.
record_title: Threshold law for projection constants of block-diagonal graph subspaces
